source_text: In contrast, medical bodies like the American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP) maintain that evidence from randomized trials and meta-analyses shows benefits outweigh risks, including a 90% reduction in penile cancer and approximately 90% lower UTI incidence (10-fold reduction) in the first year, positioning circumcision as a net positive for public health when performed neonatally under sterile conditions. [32]
